method.timestampLookup: Bounded interpolated binary search in verified block bracket 54000000..55395343; selects a block with requested whole-second timestamp when possible.
method.windowSampling: 11 blocks spaced 600 block numbers around each timestamp anchor; approximately one minute between samples, actual timestamps retained. Additional 100-block increments through each claimed minute verify the minute-level claim.
method.receiptSampling: All transactions in the highest-base-fee sampled block and the independently claimed reference block, bounded to 100 per block. Actual transaction fee = receipt.gasUsed * receipt.effectiveGasPrice.

limitations: Not an all-time maximum or full-day maximum. Sparse samples can miss brief peaks.
The article provides minute precision and no block hashes for the two September 4 peaks.
Transaction fee is computed from receipt effectiveGasPrice, not the transaction gasPrice or maxFeePerGas field.
RPC responses are evidence from named public providers, not independent consensus proofs.

backwardRefinement.method: 16 headers at 300-block intervals extending backwards from 23:31:55 UTC, approximately every 30 seconds. PublicNode; highest header cross-checked against official RPC.

sampleCoverage.scope: Two September 4 minute-centered windows, a backwards refinement around the more expensive window, and one September 5 reference block. Sparse samples; not an all-time or daily maximum.
